items.title: Morgan Stanley Spots a New Productivity Catalyst for Union Pacific (UNP)
items.summary: We just published a list of the 10 Stocks to Watch from Morgan Stanley’s Ultra-Selective Tailwinds Strategy, and Union Pacific Corporation (NYSE:UNP) ranked 6th on this list.
